name: Mibefradil

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1998 — for heart harm and muscle and bone problems

summary: Mibefradil was taken off the market worldwide starting in 1998 because it caused damage to the heart as well as muscle and bone harm [3]. In tests using a small computer model rather than studies on people, the drug received a medium risk score of 54 for liver harm [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a high risk score of 74 for heart harm [M].
